channel.title: The San Francisco Standard - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The San Francisco Standard (sfstandard.com)

item.title: The Napa town where it’s easier to win a Michelin star than build an apartment
item.description: The French Laundry Chef Thomas Keller said “non” to a controversial Yountville housing development.

item.title: An SF neighborhood goes to war over a dead theater with a housing future
item.description: West Portal merchants are mounting a protest against a nine-story residential tower set to rise above a former flickhouse.

item.title: A bartender — and a hidden cocktail bar — remaking the classics
item.description: Left Door’s Tabatha Mohn thinks everyone is making cocktails wrong. So she’s tossing the recipes in pursuit of the best versions she can make.

item.title: ‘Silicon Valley’s only contrarian’: Amjad Masad on the cost of dissent in tech
item.description: After the Replit CEO spoke out for Palestine in 2023, the tech world ghosted him. Then his company rode the AI boom to success.

item.title: Mark Madsen’s Cal turnaround could give the Bay Area multiple March Madness hopefuls
item.description: Saint Mary’s is headed for another NCAA Tournament berth, but the Gaels could have company if Cal and Santa Clara keep winning.

item.title: SF cop investigated for using Flock license plate reader data to track wife’s stolen car
item.description: In the latest abuse of Flock cameras, the officer posted images of the car on Instagram.

item.title: Blacklisted: Trump declares war on Anthropic
item.description: OpenAI’s Sam Altman has the same “red lines” as Anthropic. Will Silicon Valley finally stand united as the president rages?

item.title: Alison Roman and Christina Tosi are coming to SF for the city’s first Cookbook Week
item.description: The five-day festival will feature 20-plus authors for collab dinners, free talks, baking pop-ups, and a Pop-Up Magazine-style show.

item.title: ‘Section 415’ podcast: What we learned about 49ers GM John Lynch’s offseason priorities
item.description: Wrapping up negotiations with star left tackle Trent Williams isn’t the only important agenda item for the franchise to address in March.

item.title: Outside the strike zone: SF courts are a mess as clerks picket
item.description: Workers say chronic understaffing and inadequate training have pushed the court toward dysfunction.
